Windows Night Mode audio headroom: remove post-compressor makeup amplification (1.4 -> 1.0) and enable mpv surround-to-stereo downmix normalization only when Night Mode is ON, while preserving the 3:1 compressor and playback-speed filter. Restores normal downmix settings when OFF. Add opt-in Debug Mode checkbox to Windows Settings (OFF by default): no Night Mode diagnostic files are collected and no log-path icon is shown unless explicitly enabled. Switching Debug Mode OFF immediately stops log writes. Existing logs are not deleted. Windows-only update; iOS IPA unchanged. These changes mitigate potential clipping but do not substitute for measured output peak levels or owner listening confirmation.
